info.title: WattByte API
info.description: Accounts, device registration, per-day aggregate sync and AI summaries. Raw samples and per-app usage never leave the phone.

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for a new pair (rotation)
Sign in with Apple (not configured yet)
Sign in with Google (not configured yet)

get.summary: Account-level preferences (region, currency, electricity price mode) with the origin of each value; defaults before the first save

put.summary: Update account-level preferences and the origin of each value; omitted fields keep their value

delete.summary: Delete the account and every cloud record (GDPR erasure)
Delete the synced cloud data but keep the account
delete.description: Removes, in one transaction, the daily usage, charging and monthly summaries, AI generation log and AI quota counters. Keeps the account, its sessions, subscriptions, settings and registered devices, so sync can resume. `?devices=true` also removes the devices. Idempotent: repeating it deletes nothing and answers zeros.

get.summary: Export everything stored about the account
get.description: A JSON document (`schemaVersion`, account, settings, devices with design capacity and estimated full-charge capacity, daily usage, charging and monthly summaries, AI generation metadata, subscriptions), sent as an attachment `wattbyte-export-YYYY-MM-DD.json`. Never contains the password hash, sessions or refresh tokens, or another user's data. `?format=csv` returns only the daily usage as RFC 4180 `text/csv; charset=utf-8`. At most 10000 rows per collection (the newest); a cut collection is flagged in `limits.truncated` (CSV: header `x-wattbyte-truncated`).

post.summary: Register (or refresh) this installation; idempotent per installationId
post.description: Battery capacity travels in two groups that are stored atomically: the design capacity of the model (designCapacityMah / designCapacityWh / designCapacitySource) and the estimated full-charge capacity of this battery (estimatedFullChargeCapacityMah / estimatedFullChargeCapacityWh / fullChargeCapacitySource / fullChargeCapacityConfidence). A group whose source is given replaces the stored group as a whole (nulls included); a group with a null source leaves the stored one untouched. A design capacity needs a source other than unknown; an estimate needs source androidChargeCounter and a confidence; Wh needs mAh. Violations are 400 validation.

get.summary: Design (nominal) battery capacity for a model identifier (iOS utsname.machine or Android Build.MODEL)
get.description: Served from the shared device catalog (packages/device-specs); every figure is a design capacity of the model, never a measurement. 404 when the model is not listed; the app then reports the capacity as unknown rather than guessing.

post.summary: Upload per-day aggregates for one installation; safe to repeat

Average household electricity price per kWh for a country (defaults to the account country)
get.description: A statistical average from a public source (Eurostat nrg_pc_204, band DC, taxes included), cached server-side. Never a wholesale or spot price and never the user's own tariff. 404 when no source covers the country.
